title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish from Arabia, featuring marinated chicken cooked to perfection on the grill.

ingredients.name: Quick Arabian spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: Crispy sumac
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Arabian spice mix, sumac, lime juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with the vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
